_comment: Stock for every Sleeve Seller NPC. The top-level key is the NPC's shop_id (set in All_NPC_Constant_Data.json; defaults to the slugified NPC name). Sleeve names are bare basenames exactly as they appear in Image_Assets/Sleeves/ and in the player's progress 'sleeves' array — no extension. Add a new seller by adding a new block here and pointing an NPC's shop_id at it.
